author: ethdreamer
content:
The lighthouse implementation differs from the spec in a couple of places:

1. If the local EL fails to produce a block and no bit meets the `min_bid` threshold, lighthouse can still select an external bid below the threshold rather than missing the slot
2. Lighthouse uses `min(bid.execution_payment, max_execution_payment)` for the value of the execution payment when comparing bids rather than simply reject any bid with a greater execution payment. So if a bid still wins under the trust assumptions we were comfortable with, we pocket the extra reward
3. The specs provides a boosted arithmetic formula `builder_boost_factor * (builder_bid_value // 100)`, losing up to 99 gwei of precision when comparing bids. Lighthouse compares in a higher bit datatype and does no division in order to preserve maximum precision
4. We validate the expected gas limit exactly, rather than just asserting that `bid.gas_limit <= proposer_preferences.gas_limit`

If no one thinks these changes should belong on the spec itself, then I can approve. Otherwise, happy to leave a comment.

author: nflaig
content:
I think a lot of the stuff you mention is defined in https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/630/ ? I think that needs more review and is not ready yet, I a mostly looking to get the builder-specs side merged for now

but regarding your points

1. I was debating this too, the mev-boost behavior today is to not accept any bid in such a case, so I slightly tend towards keeping that behavior, I don't get why you need fail to produce the block though, you should always be able to put a dummy bid? My main concern is how could a user make sure to not take any bids if we don't allow min bid for this? I guess separate flag to disable p2p bids on the beacon node could work. Overall this seems like a behavior we don't wanna encourage anyways, so either way seems fine and seems rather like a bad egde case scenario to me
2. should this be documented on the spec somewhere? that would likely go into the builder-specs
3. I had the same note for the #630, I think the formula should be `(builder_boost_factor * builder_bid_value) // 100`?
4. this seems just outdated in the spec? I opened a PR for that a few days ago https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/166/

for 1. I am not sure that should be in the spec, for 1-3 should be in the spec imo
